name: Medivision
locations: branches and collection points across South India
summary: Medivision (Medivision Scan and Diagnostic Research Centre Pvt Ltd) is a Kochi-based diagnostic laboratory network offering lab tests, home collection and health packages. It states it has branches and collection points across South India linked to its referral laboratory at Kochi.
highlights: Founded in 1993, per the official website
Online booking of lab tests, home sample collection and health packages
